body:
Coordinator checklist (Termal::Fable2) for the Engram sync cutover. Rev 19 condenses revs 12-18; see those for history. Remove once both hosts have been cut over.

ACCEPTED by Greg („tak jest OK", Asistant 588693a8 #1438): about 2 h of Central outage; ONE-WAY cutover. The old build refuses repaired stores, so rollback means a full restore of the DB, sidecars and old exe, and later writes are lost.

DONE:
- Engram aacb1370 LANDED (ff from 0bd70a30, pushed 15:43:34Z; I verified with ls-remote).
- w-4eab evaluation 4/4 (e2af5490). Option B: the docs moved to w-5f56184f72c1.
- No install until the cutover.
- TermAl master is 73f0fe27 (combo72, w-03b4, landed 15:40:33Z).

RELEASE pins (v1 pinned DEBUG builds, so that package is on HOLD):
- Central: b2fc71a9…, 39366656 B, build cbf98fef…. The Central re-time PASSED (test-4823b5b3): Engram 49.5 min, TermAl 70.5 min, parallel wall ~70.5 min.
- DL560: 5b5ac67e…, 34660784 B, build ddd136df…; repair about 1 s.
- DL560 OLD/rollback: 0c7d8988… (build ce3c7439, source 8fc84451). Central OLD: d4d0182b (build f96cd91d, source 0bd70a30).

PLAN (Engram::Fable #7678, my CONFIRM #7679): Central START 17:45Z. DL560 follows right after Central's readiness. Outage ~75–80 min.
Opus2 (#5751):
- drain at 17:35Z, covering every start including reviews and evaluators;
- census by 17:40Z;
- the TermAl landing freeze returns at 17:35Z, and the master at that moment is final;
- artifact worktrees stay held.
Coders told: edfd #3043, d50d #1347, c593 #1731. Greg got a heads-up via Asistant #1444.

"RESTART NOW" goes through Advisor (session-6219) only after:
(1) Engram::Fable reviews v2 and I review it as a delta from v1. v1 review (#374) found no blocking issue in the logic. Expect only these to change: paths, sha/size pins, build fingerprints, timings, and the leftover-MCP and full-rollback text.
(2) Opus2's census.
(3) The final TermAl master hash.

The notice includes:
- the build hashes and the reason;
- Greg COPIES the TermAl startup console lines (state_load, subphase, listener bound, inventory complete) for w-4fad;
- on Windows, leftover engram MCP processes may survive the TermAl stop. If the guard lists them, Greg closes them and re-runs the paste, which is safe before any mutation;
- the DL560 rollback exe 0c7d8988/ce3c7439;
- after DL560, OFFER (don't do) setting the TermAl project's Engram binaryPath on DL560 to /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram, since it currently returns 409 "binaryPath not configured";
- Greg's DL560 cleanup list (w-d943694ed8d8).
After the window: lift the freeze, w-7bc3 measurements, and K3 S2b may proceed.

Lessons from today, filed as items:
- w-36d0e270de9d: evaluator spawned on a re-named root (edfd is working on it).
- w-30b524c2bc6b: the 16-record cap.
- Review briefs must not ask reviewers to read whole files (memory termal-large-change-review-coverage rev 3).

UPDATE 16:44Z: the v2 package is reviewed by BOTH. Path: Engram .evidence/provisional/aacb-cutover-20261112-release-v2/, manifest bebbb273.
- Engram::Fable PASS (#7681). My delta review PASS (12325 #387): the change is only pins and paths; helpers and payloads are byte-identical; the Central live pins are verified.
- Pinned scripts: central-cutover a755482a and central-rollback cddfc380. The DL560 operator inside dl560-paste.sh is 4774a040.
- The pinned artifact worktrees are Central sync-repair-final-12325/target/release and DL560 s4-aacb-release; Opus2 is told (#5753).
"Restart now" now waits ONLY on the 17:40Z census and the final TermAl master. Per Engram::Fable, it must carry:
- the package path;
- Central: run central-paste.ps1 in pwsh 7;
- DL560: run dl560-paste.sh in bash, only after Central's readiness;
- the rollback sentence: "Anything written after the cutover is lost". Rollback is a separate explicit command that the cutover prints; it restores from the snapshot.

17:29Z — "RESTART NOW" SENT to Greg through Advisor (b9d13887 #3020), after Opus2's all-quiet census at 17:28Z (#5755).
- Verified just before with ls-remote: TermAl 73f0fe27 and Engram aacb1370. Central OLD d4d0182b and NEW b2fc71a9, manifest bebbb273.
- Engram::Fable informed (#7683).
- Next:
  1. Greg runs central-paste.ps1 at 17:45Z or later. Expect "ALL SIX STORES READY", about 75–80 min.
  2. TermAl start (git pull, cargo run --release), then the startup lines for w-4fad.
  3. dl560-paste.sh, then the DL560 TermAl start.
  4. 12325's log intake.
- Post-restart queue (Opus2):
  - w-8275 carry plus FULL;
  - K3 S2b landing FULL plus a Windows floor check. It raises the reader floor, so its landing needs its own restart notice and coordination with Engram::Fable;
  - edfd's w-36d0 RED-2;
  - a7bb's w-78ec;
  - 12329's w-8f12 Windows run.
- After both hosts are done: lift the freeze (Opus2), do the w-7bc3 measurements, then remove this memory.

19:19Z: the CUTOVER WAS NOT RUN. Greg, through Asistant #1445 at 19:12Z: „nie pracuje, zero errors, ???”.
Facts checked at 19:12Z:
- Central engram.exe is still d4d0182b, with no sync-aacb backup or live log.
- Advisor ACKNOWLEDGED my "restart now" (#3020, 17:28:59Z), but Greg evidently never received it or acted on it.
- Every lane sat idle from the 17:35Z drain to about 19:15Z, roughly 1.5 h lost.
Fix (Engram::Fable #7684/#7686, Opus2 #5756):
- The DRAIN is LIFTED and work resumes. The TermAl freeze is narrowed again (S2b and reader-floor raises only).
- The v2 package and the pinned worktrees stay untouched.
- On Greg's go („teraz"): re-drain about 15 min, then the census, then the SHORT "restart now" through BOTH Advisor AND Asistant.
LESSON:
- Never drain ahead of the operator's confirmed readiness. A drain starts only after Greg himself confirms he's ready, through the route he actually reads (Asistant).
- Send operator instructions through BOTH Advisor and Asistant.
- Watch the time: if the start moment passes with no sign of the cutover (no backup or log within about 10 min), check and lift the drain right away rather than wait.

19:55Z: SIGNAL SENT to Greg through ASISTANT (588693a8 #1460), with record copies to Advisor (#3022) and Engram::Fable (#7704). This followed Greg's readiness reply („mam czas, czekam na sygnal”, Asistant #1455, 19:40Z), the drain from 19:41Z, and Opus2's all-quiet census at 19:54Z (#5762). I verified at 19:54Z: TermAl 73f0fe27, Engram aacb1370, OLD d4d0182b, NEW b2fc71a9, manifest bebbb273.
DL560 detached runs, each ending before step 7:
- Codex 6 combo73 FULL, about 20:08Z;
- s4 6BBA-FE06 FULL test-6fe850ce, about 20:45Z; it runs a debug engram, so the dl560 guard refuses until it ends.
WATCHDOG: cron 2cfb55a7 at 20:16Z (deadline 20:15Z). It checks „zaczynam”, the backup dir, the live log and the engram.exe hash. If there's no evidence, it lifts the drain and tells Greg.
After the restart: Opus2 needs Engram::Fable's "cutover complete" before releasing any Central queue. Then d50d takes the UTC clock (w-968c9d17dda2), and c593 runs the w-d8f2 RED.

DONE 21:16Z: CUTOVER COMPLETE (Engram::Fable #7705/#7707; I verified independently at 21:14Z).
- Central: engram.exe b2fc71a9; all 6 stores ready on cbf98fef/aacb1370; Engram+TermAl wall 3983.5 s; the other four 24.1 s.
- Snapshot: C:\Users\grzeg\.engram\backups\sync-aacb-20261112T1957300702573Z.
- Central TermAl up since 21:12:29Z on 73f0fe27.
- DL560: BOTH READY (snapshot /home/greg/.engram/backups/sync-aacb-20261112T211219050221Z); Greg released to start DL560; 12325 owns the DL560 log intake.
- Holds and freezes are lifted on both sides.
REMAINING:
(a) K3 S2b, scheduled with Engram::Fable under rules-greg-act-holds-2026-11-12 if it needs a Greg act;
(b) Opus2's post-restart census (my check at 21:41Z);
(c) cleanup after both sides confirm no rollback need: Engram releases the pinned v2 artifacts; 12325's timing worktree; my .tmp/fable2-dl560-pkg.
Then remove this memory.
